identity.name: Fisher Island
identity.notes: A private, man-made island in Biscayne Bay and one of the most exclusive residential communities in the United States. The roughly 2-square-mile island is part of the City of Miami Beach and features about 3.5 miles of private Atlantic beachfront and some of the most valuable homes in the country. Access is controlled entirely by a single private toll drawbridge from Mid-Beach Miami Beach.

fees.note: Fisher Island does not have a conventional monthly HOA dues structure. Access is controlled via the private toll drawbridge: non-resident visitors pay a per-vehicle toll (historically reported around $15-$25), while residents receive a key fob and generally cross toll-free. Exact amounts vary and are not consistently published.

amenities.detail: The island's sole point of entry is a private toll drawbridge from Miami Beach, staffed and fob-controlled — effectively a gatehouse for the entire community.
Approximately 3.5 miles of private Atlantic Ocean beachfront along the island's seaward side.
Private residents' yacht marina on Biscayne Bay.
Residents' clubhouse/club facility (Fisher Island Club) with social and dining spaces.
Pool at the residents' club facility.
No golf course on the island itself; the private 18-hole Shores Golf Club is located on adjacent Shores Island, just across the water.

demographics.geography_level: Island community, Miami Beach (Census tract level), Miami-Dade County, FL — 2020 Census; very small population, figures are approximate and vary by source (often cited in the ~450-600 range).
